reply: {"verses": [], "overall": "The translation follows the Latin closely throughout: tenses (future persequeris/turbabis/quaerent), moods (jussive erubescant/conturbentur/confundantur/pereant/cognoscant) and persons are preserved, the concrete images (rota, stipula, stercus terrae, ignis/flamma) are kept, and the proper names are all present. Paraphrastic touches such as 'formaram com malícia um desígnio' (malignaverunt consilium) and 'como nação' (de gente) are within the sense of the Latin, and the pointing marks match the Latin (one mediant per verse, in the same place)."}
